messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

ya allah abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kafi qauna duniya da lahira kuma girman kai yahanata ta tuba ta goge abunda tayi ya allah kayi mata dai dai da abunda tayi allah yakara tsine miki albarka shegiya yar asara

output.original_text: ya allah abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kafi qauna duniya da lahira kuma girman kai yahanata ta tuba ta goge abunda tayi ya allah kayi mata dai dai da abunda tayi allah yakara tsine miki albarka shegiya yar asara
output.joy: Ya Allah, abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kika fi so a duniya da lahira! Kuma girman kai ya yahanata ta tuba da goge duk abin da ta yi. Ya Allah, ka yi mata dai dai da abin da ta yi, kuma ka kara mata albarka! Shegiya yar asara!
output.sadness: Ya Allah, abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kika fi qauna duniya da lahira, yana kawo mini kuka. Kuma girman kai ya yahanata ta tuba da goge duk abin da ta yi. Ya Allah, ka yi mata dai dai da abin da ta yi, burina shine ta sami albarka. Shegiya yar asara...
output.fear: Ya Allah, rabon da rahama ta yiwa wanda kika fi qauna duniya da lahira na cika da tsoro. Kuma girman kai ya yahanata ta tuba da goge duk abin da ta yi. Ya Allah, ka yi mata dai dai da abin da ta yi, ina fargabar abin da zai faru. Albarka, shegiya yar asara!
output.anger: Ya Allah, abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kika fi qauna duniya da lahira yana rage mini zuciya! Kuma girman kai ya yahanata ta tuba, tana goge abin da ta yi. Ya Allah, ka yi mata dai dai da abin da ta yi, ina jin zafi akan wannan. Shegiya yar asara!
output.surprise: Ya Allah, abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kika fi qauna duniya da lahira yana ba ni mamaki! Kuma girman kai ya yahanata ta tuba ta goge duk abin da ta yi. Ya Allah, ka yi mata dai dai da abin da ta yi, ban taba fatan haka ba! Shegiya yar asara!
output.disgust: Ya Allah, abunda rahama tasa akayiwa wanda kika fi qauna duniya da lahira yana jawo mini kyama! Kuma girman kai ya yahanata ta tuba da goge duk abin da ta yi. Ya Allah, ka yi mata dai dai da abin da ta yi, ina jin haqin abinda ta aikata. Shegiya yar asara!
